footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Marathon Petroleum: after $1.8B attributable to noncontrolling interests, $4.0M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 3.7% to $135.2B in 2025. Gross margin was 11.7%, versus 10.1% a year earlier, and operating income rose 22.0% to $8.3B, a 6.1% margin.
Net income rose 17.5% to $4.0B, or $13.22 per share. Operating cash flow was $8.3B and free cash flow $4.8B, versus $6.1B; Marathon Petroleum returned $4.6B through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Marathon Petroleum Corporation Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
